name: The Last Gardener
visual_description: A lithe, humanoid figure with exposed wiring and golden filaments instead of skin. It holds its own arm like a relic.
meaning: The servant who tended the ruins. Repair without direction.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh left caretakers behind.** They tried to preserve your parks, your songs, your laughter—long after you were ash. This one still tries.
